models.name: todo_users
models.description:
User account and authentication record for the minimal Todo List application.

Represents an individual user with private access to their own todo items. Stores unique email for identity, a securely hashed password for authentication, and all fields required for secure registration and sign-in per MVP requirements.

Each user entry is isolated to ensure privacy and prevent any cross-user access. Removal of a user cascades to all dependent sessions and todos for privacy and compliance. No role or privilege fields: users are always basic end-users in this system.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the user. Unique, unguessable identifier for user account records.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address for authentication and identity recovery. Must be unique in the system per privacy and login requirements.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt or Argon2 hash of the user's password. Never stores plain text; used solely for authentication and verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the most recent update to this user's account (email, password, etc.).

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description:
Audit and security tracking of authentication sessions for each user.

Stores login session metadata (creation, expiration), and connection context (IP, referrer, visited URL). Each session references a user and is removed if the user is deleted. Provides the backbone for authentication flows, token invalidation, and session management per privacy, security, and audit requirements. No device or user agent fields included as MVP requires only essential context for traceability.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the session. Unique identifier for each authentication session instance.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the owner of this session. Links each session to a specific user. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated for auditing and session traceability.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL at the time session was created, for security audit and origin verification.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer when session was created, for basic session tracing and anti-abuse context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the session was established.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the session expired, was revoked, or logged out. Null if session is active.

models.name: todo_todos
models.description:
Primary table storing all todo items for the application. Each todo is exclusively owned and managed by a single authenticated user.

This model represents the complete lifecycle of a user's personal todo task. It enforces strict privacy: only the owning user may create, view, update, toggle, or delete the todo. All business, security, and audit requirements are enforced through the schema, supporting item creation, description editing, status toggling (complete/incomplete), and permanent deletion.

Timestamps for creation, last update, and completion are recorded for auditing and workflow support. The table is strictly normalized; every todo is directly linked to a user through a non-null foreign key, ensuring there are never any orphaned todos. All content length and validation constraints are implemented at the DB level, with additional protection against user ID abuse or cross-user access through user_id indexing.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each todo item.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key linking to the owning user. Must always reference an existing user. Required for all CRUD operations and ensures strict privacy. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: User-supplied description of the todo item. Must be between 1 and 255 characters after whitespace is trimmed. Required for creation and all updates.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. True if complete, false if incomplete. Default is false on creation.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the todo was last marked as complete. Null if never completed or reset when marked incomplete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the todo was created. Always set at creation and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to any todo property. Always updated when description or completion status changes.
